title: On File System Permissions
author: Apple Developer Technical Support
applicable_facts: Root processes remain subject to mandatory access control.
Files and Folders consent prompts depend on GUI login context.
Responsible code and stable code identity affect attribution; inheriting GUI/audit identity does not prove consent.
local_evidence: stage172 fixed Terminal/sudo root UID0 retained audit UID501 and GUI/audit session100022.
inference: Try a specifically approved Terminal launch with fail-closed login admission to isolate context; this is not a verified TCC fix.
